summary: SHF Holdings filed an 8-K regarding a voluntary reduction of the conversion price of Series B Preferred Stock to $0.65 and a reduction of the cash exercise price of Series B Warrants to $0.65, effective until July 31, 2026. The company intends to file an S-1 to register shares issuable upon exercise. This is a routine adjustment to equity-linked securities, not a special situation such as a tender offer, capital return, or restructuring. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, going-private, spin-off, or liquidation is present. The filing is a financing-related update with no change of control or restructuring implications.
